_about: Host acceptance status for PumpCurve 0.4.2. This is the only place DAW status
is stated, and release_gate.py refuses a 'verified' or 'discovery_verified'
claim whose evidence artifact does not exist (it hashes what it finds).
'discovery_verified' means the host lists the plug-in; it is NOT insertion or
Evidence paths are resolved against SIDECHAIN's evidence root

logic_pro.note: Logic's Plug-In Manager validates the AU and the system advertises aufx SdCh Musc as Music-Prod: PumpCurve, but the Audio FX list omits third-party AUs from several vendors, so insertion was never achieved and is not claimed.

fl_studio.note: The earlier discovery evidence (run12-20261010/logs/fl-db-rebuilt) was on the external volume that is no longer attached and cannot be re-hashed, so the discovery claim is withdrawn until FL Studio is tested again with the current build. FL Studio 2026 (26.1.7.5419) is installed on the test Mac.

ableton_live.note: Ableton Live is not installed on this machine and no licence was obtained.

windows_daw.note: No Windows host or DAW exists here. The CI installer test proves install/upgrade/uninstall behaviour, which is not DAW acceptance.
